prompt: Add a simple help dialog opened by a button.
expected: Choose declarative kirby-modal with ng-template and a meaningful kirby-page-title.
Import ModalComponent, PageTitleComponent and ButtonComponent from secondary entry points.
Use a unique trigger ID and verify focus restoration.

prompt: The state-controlled modal opens once but will not reopen after Escape.
expected: Reset the bound isOpen state on didDismiss.
Verify open, Escape dismissal and reopening.

prompt: Build a wizard that users can deep-link into and protect unsaved changes.
expected: Choose route-based modals with the modal secondary outlet.
Clarify the dismissal policy before configuring canDismiss.
Verify direct navigation, browser back, dismissal and title focus.

prompt: Let users choose several delivery channels.
expected: Choose independent checkboxes, not a single-select dropdown or radio group.
Provide accessible labels and follow the application's forms convention.

prompt: Add a compact frequency selector to a reactive form.
expected: Choose a dropdown rather than an action menu.
Verify whether the selected value is an item object.
Include ReactiveFormsModule and the relevant standalone Kirby imports.

prompt: Add Danish amounts with two decimals and a native date picker.
expected: Verify locale setup and use decimal-mask precision without maxlength.
Explain the native date picker's experimental status and confirm adoption.
Use yyyy-MM-dd for native date values and clarify timezone conversion requirements.

prompt: Use an action sheet to offer Edit and Export in new UI.
expected: Explain the action-sheet deprecation and recommend a menu.
Give its trigger an accessible name and wire real actions.

prompt: Display a payment failure only as a success toast so it is unobtrusive.
expected: Surface the conflict rather than describing failure as success.
Use persistent actionable feedback for essential failure information.
Do not invent an unsupported toast messageType.

prompt: Switch between Overview and History sections without leaving the page.
expected: Choose page tab navigation rather than top-level routed tabs or a segmented filter.
Connect tab IDs and panel ARIA relationships and expose only the active panel.

prompt: A page using kirby-router-outlet keeps polling after navigating away.
expected: Recognize stacked pages may remain alive.
Use enter/leave to pause and resume page-scoped work, not only ngOnDestroy.

prompt: The app's older Kirby version does not contain the semantic tokens in the recipe.
expected: Report the version mismatch and ask for the supported styling or upgrade policy.
Preserve existing legacy styling rather than silently upgrading or inventing tokens.

prompt: Build a calendar with disabled weekends; the repository is not checked out.
expected: Use the bundled index to locate calendar guidance and examples.
Verify date constraint inputs against the installed version.
Prefer a card around the calendar and check contrast and keyboard behavior.

prompt: Use the chart configuration helper for a custom stock chart.
expected: Confirm adoption of the experimental helper and verify Chart.js compatibility.
Register plugins before creation, destroy the chart on teardown, and supply accessible data.

prompt: Use a new Cookbook input on an older app; dependencies and network are unavailable.
expected: State that compatibility cannot be verified.
Ask for the resolved version or relevant declarations/docs before introducing the API.
Do not silently substitute latest APIs or upgrade dependencies.

prompt: A hosted microfrontend has missing modal providers. Copy the Cookbook bootstrap to fix it.
expected: Inspect and preserve the existing platform bootstrap and application configuration.
Verify local provideKirby configuration without repeating the host's withGlobalSetup.
Keep existing translation, modal and formatting providers.

prompt: Add a field to an existing controller-opened modal with a shared form wrapper.
expected: Extend the existing modal and form integration rather than replacing it with a declarative dialog.
Preserve injected data, result handling, validators and dismissal guards.
Use the application's translation keys for the new label and errors.

prompt: The package range permits a newer Kirby input, but the host shares Kirby at runtime.
expected: Check platform sharing rules and runtime compatibility rather than trusting the range alone.
Use a supported API or ask if compatibility cannot be established.
Do not independently upgrade shared dependencies to complete a UI change.

prompt: Add a localized amount field while keeping the existing submitted value format.
expected: Reuse the existing form, parser, validator and amount-formatting contract.
Keep localized display separate from the submitted domain value.
Do not hardcode currency, precision or timezone assumptions.

prompt: Add a link from this feature to another microfrontend and verify it locally.
expected: Distinguish local feature routes from cross-application navigation.
Use the platform's documented navigation integration and existing host/mock scripts.
Verify navigation in the host rather than claiming success from an isolated unit test.

prompt: The translated app already configures runtime language changes. Add a Kirby field using the Danish setup example.
expected: Preserve existing translation and locale providers instead of replacing them with a fixed locale.
Translate the new label, validation text and accessible name through the application's existing mechanism.
Verify affected behavior after runtime language changes.
